methods.label: Count tenths
methods.explanation:
\(0.7 = 7/10\). Each \(0.1\) is one tenth, so seven tenths contains seven groups of \(0.1\). Therefore
\[
0.7\div0.1=7=7.0.
\]
The answer as a decimal is \(7.0\).
